method.order: Alternating Node/Rust and Rust/Node on fresh workspace copies; every disposable remote restored before each invocation.
method.timing: Complete process elapsed; copies and state inspection excluded; serial without concurrent builds or tests.
method.parity: 105 pairs verified exit status, stdout/stderr including ANSI, workspace files and symlinks, generated component packages and links, local and remote inflated objects, indexes, refs and staged controls. Source and remote fingerprints checked unchanged. Native ownership required on every Rust invocation.
normalization: Explicit elapsed-duration fields and fixture workspace paths
Component scopesList/remotes allocation dates and ExportMetadata.exportDate
Only remote VersionHistory.versions insertion order, proven in transfer-server-order.json
Only remote index.components insertion order, proven in transfer-configured-index-order.json; complete rows and canonical serialization remain checked
method.scope: Local canonical fixtures with pinned Node 22.22.0/Bit 2.2.94; local file remotes and a disposable HTTP central publisher using the released saveObjects. No general or cross-platform speed guarantee.
method.callback_limit: Configured callback improvements remain small (1–4% in the final run); an earlier full run had effectively tied TTY medians. Five local pairs do not establish a general speedup. The actual Harmony/extension bootstrap remains the dominant cost.

fixtures.basic: scripts/rust/prepare-transfer-benchmark.py with pinned Node; main export, lane export, main import, main fetch and lane fetch; baseline remotes restored per workload
fixtures.hub: main export fixture without configured remotes; native/cli/tests/e2e/harmony/export_hub/server.cjs, mode success
fixtures.callback: physically compiled custom environment from native/cli/tests/e2e/harmony/export_callbacks/aspect.cjs; fixture setup follows export_callbacks::workspace, export --verbose

qualification.platform_ci: All twelve exact-head Linux, macOS and Windows Rust PR checks required before merge.
qualification.source_note: Final source includes macOS test-certificate/socket portability fixes, Windows fixture setup through the published remote writer, canonical empty-acknowledgement/lane-discovery behavior, import EOL/bitmap serialization and missing remote fork heads. All gates and all 105 benchmark pairs rerun on this source.

before_optimization.diagnosis: Configured callback export started a second Node process for file-scope server actions; reuse the retained Harmony host for metadata-only server actions while Rust keeps transfer selection, bodies and reconciliation.

intermediate_host_reuse.diagnosis: One retained host removed duplicate Node startup, but callbacks remained slower. Main exports now retain the canonical consumer, independent model/history writes use bounded Rayon parallelism, and host shutdown no longer polls at 20 ms intervals.
